skill.name: broken-yaml-skill
skill.description: Broken YAML fixture for packager failure testing.
skill.summary: Broken YAML fixture for packager failure testing.
skill.author: yaojingang

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The flagged line is descriptive metadata, and no evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration, external commands, or unsafe runtime behavior.

remediation.issue: Malformed YAML in the agent interface fixture
remediation.suggestion: Fix the unterminated adapter target value before using this as a publishable skill package.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 3 only states that the fixture contains invalid YAML. It does not request system reconnaissance, collect host data, or instruct the model to inspect the environment.

content.value_statement: Skill packages can fail when metadata files contain malformed YAML. This fixture helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows test package validation failures.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal skill package with valid SKILL metadata.
Includes an intentionally malformed agent interface YAML file.
Supports testing package validators against invalid metadata.
Helps reproduce packager failure handling in CI workflows.
Documents that the package is a fixture for failure testing.
limitations: It is not a functional end-user skill.
The interface YAML is intentionally invalid.
It does not repair YAML files automatically.
It should not be published as a production skill package.

use_cases.title: Test package validation
use_cases.description: Confirm that a skill packager rejects malformed interface YAML with a clear error.

use_cases.title: Exercise CI failure paths
use_cases.description: Use the fixture to verify that build pipelines stop on invalid skill metadata.

use_cases.title: Teach metadata requirements
use_cases.description: Compare this fixture with a valid package to explain YAML syntax requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the fixture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill fixture and explain why it is useful for package validation testing.

prompt_templates.title: Find the validation failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the skill files and identify which metadata file prevents successful packaging.

prompt_templates.title: Design a CI check
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a validation plan that uses this fixture to confirm CI fails on malformed YAML metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Compare failure behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare validator output for this broken fixture and a valid skill package, then summarize coverage gaps.

output_examples.output: This fixture tests whether a packager detects malformed interface metadata and reports a clear failure.
The package should fail validation because the agent interface YAML contains an unterminated value.

output_examples.input: Describe a CI use for this package.
output_examples.output: A CI pipeline can run validation against this fixture and verify that the build fails as expected.

best_practices: Use this fixture only in validation tests or documentation.
Pair it with a valid fixture to confirm both pass and fail paths.
Check that validator errors name the malformed metadata file.
anti_patterns: Do not present this fixture as a working production skill.
Do not suppress validation errors from malformed YAML.
Do not use it to test unrelated runtime behavior.

faq.question: Is this a working skill?
faq.answer: No. It is a fixture designed to fail package validation.

faq.question: Why does the package fail?
faq.answer: The agent interface metadata contains malformed YAML.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude?
faq.answer: Yes, but only as a validation fixture for Claude-related skill tooling.

faq.question: Can it be used with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can inspect it or use it in packaging tests.

faq.question: Does it access files or networks?
faq.answer: No evidence found of runtime file access, network access, or command execution.

faq.question: Should this be published to users?
faq.answer: No. Publish a corrected package unless the marketplace supports test fixtures.
